en.headline: Ho Man Tin luxury site draws at least 10 bids at noon close
en.dek: The Fat Kwong Street residential site closed at noon with at least 10 tenders, including bids from major developers, reports said.
body: A government residential site on Fat Kwong Street in Ho Man Tin closed for tender at noon on Friday and drew at least 10 bids, according to on-site counts reported by local outlets.

Reports named Chinachem, CK Asset, K. Wah International, Sino Land, China Overseas Land and Poly Property among the bidders, with Sun Hung Kai Properties confirming it had submitted a sole bid. K. Wah's director of development and leasing for Hong Kong property said the firm bid on its own and would set its price with reference to nearby transactions.

The site covers about 55,651 square feet and is designated for private housing, with a maximum gross floor area of about 207,749 square feet and room for roughly 250 flats, outlets reported. Market estimates cited in those reports ranged from about HK$1.87 billion to HK$3.12 billion.

The winning developer must build a neighbourhood elderly centre and a branch of an integrated community centre for mental wellness, and complete the project by the end of December 2031. Reports described the plot as the first residential government site offered in Ho Man Tin in more than 10 years; the previous one, on Sheung Shing Street, was sold in March 2016 for more than HK$6.38 billion.

zh.headline: 何文田佛光街住宅地中午截標 最少10份標書
zh.dek: 何文田佛光街私人住宅用地中午截標，現場最少收到10份標書，多間大型發展商入標。
body: 政府推出的何文田佛光街住宅用地星期五中午12時截標。本地媒體引述現場點算，最少收到10份標書。
報道所列發展商包括華懋、長實、嘉華國際、信和置業、中國海外發展及保利置業，新鴻基地產確認以獨資形式入標。嘉華國際發展及租務總監（香港地產）表示以獨資投標，出價會參考附近成交。
該地約55,651平方呎，指定作私人住宅，可建總樓面約207,749平方呎，預計可建約250伙。媒體引述的市場估值約18.7億至31.2億港元。
中標發展商須興建長者鄰舍中心分處及精神健康綜合社區中心分處，並須於2031年12月底前完成項目。報道指這是何文田逾10年來首幅推出的住宅官地，上一幅常盛街豪宅地於2016年3月以逾63.8億元批出。
